schedule: seed-blocked, balanced randomized order; strictly serial; no discarded/retried failures
validity: state OK AND pose_set AND finite normalized transform AND successful actual final tracking stage
gt_association: fixed input-to-GT mapping using all input times, max difference .02 s; duplicate GT timestamp keeps last
alignment_for_online_quality: single transform fitted on ALL GT-eligible inputs within first 2 dataset seconds; mean relative orientation projected to SO(3), mean translation; no scale; no realignment after loss/map reset
calibration_missing_policy: if any predeclared calibration input lacks an accepted pose, mark calibration failed and full-sequence quality unavailable/zero, never move the window
quality_denominator: all predeclared GT-matched input frames, identical for every version/run
recovery: start at first unaccepted input, end at first of 5 consecutive accepted and primary-quality-compliant GT-matched inputs; unresolved events retained as right-censored
accuracy: final optimized trajectory, accepted timestamps only; per-run support and 20-way common RPY support; SE3 alignment, fixed scale 1; shared nearest-1s RPE pair lists
efficiency: all input frames, median/p95 ms and deadline misses; same observer overhead; no recording
